calls.title: Board Prep Session
calls.summary: The team outlined key FY27 goals targeting a range of $16-20 million, emphasizing strategic positioning, adaptability to market changes, and high-level metrics for board presentation. Discussions included addressing a 35% annual churn and potential 3-5% expansion ARR from Pro to Enterprise. The board's interest was identified as focusing more on growth strategy and execution speed rather than granular details. AI emerged as a major opportunity and challenge, with a strategic partnership with Anthropic underscoring collaborative innovation. Q4 showcased 113% year-over-year growth and expansion ARR significantly exceeding previous quarters. Plans for international growth highlighted AI-powered translation partnerships while validating local market interest before full commitments. Hiring momentum was a key point, driving capabilities in product delivery and customer success.
calls.keywords: AI Integration, FY27 Goals, Anthropic Partnership, Pro ARR, Managed Warehouse, International Expansion
